title: Creating parts is unchanged, a rename applies to every location with history
custom_preconds:
1. You are editing an existing inventory part via the Edit Inventory Part dialog, with "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit".
  2. The part's Part Library entry is also stocked at other locations.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm New Inventory Part still has the plain Part Number field of Story 7.
  2. Open the inline field and read any multi-location note.
  3. Save a new number and check where the new vs old number shows (documents vs reports/list/history).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Creating a part is unchanged (New Inventory Part keeps the plain Part Number field); a Part Library entry is shared by every location, so a new number applies at every location that stocks the part.
  • While the field is open, if at least one other location stocks the same entry the dialog shows "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one; counts active and inactive), and nothing when no other location stocks it; existing work orders/estimates/invoices/part sales/purchase orders/receipts/returns keep the number they were saved with, while reports, the Inventory list and Part History show the new number.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 13 (Edit the part number of an existing part); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R11: “Creating a part is unchanged. The New Inventory Part dialog keeps the plain Part Number field of Story 7.”
  • S13-R12: “A Part Library entry is shared by every location in the organization, so the new number applies at every location that stocks the part, not only the one where it was edited.”
  • S13-R13: “While the Part Number field is open, if at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." under the hint, or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one. Parts at those locations count whether they are active or inactive. When no other location stocks it, nothing extra is shown.”
  • S13-R14: “Work orders, estimates, invoices, part sales, purchase orders, receipts and returns keep the part number they were saved with. Reports, the Inventory list and Part History show the new number.”
